mapper.sql:
SELECT st.*, gp.province_name, gc.city_name, s.real_name, gm.* FROM statistics st
LEFT JOIN grid_province gp ON st.province_id = gp.province_id
LEFT JOIN grid_city gc ON st.city_id = gc.city_id
LEFT JOIN supervisor s ON st.fd_id = s.tel_id
LEFT JOIN grid_member gm ON st.gm_id = gm.gm_id
mapper.select: SELECT gp.province_id AS province_id, gp.province_name AS province_name, gp.province_abbr AS province_abbr, SUM(CASE WHEN st.so2_level > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS so2_count, SUM(CASE WHEN st.co_level > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS co_count, SUM(CASE WHEN st.spm_level > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS spm_count, SUM(CASE WHEN st.aqi_id > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aqi_count FROM grid_province gp LEFT JOIN statistics st ON st.province_id = gp.province_id GROUP BY gp.province_id, gp.province_name, gp.province_abbr ORDER BY gp.province_id ASC

SELECT aqi.aqi_id AS aqi_id, aqi.aqi_explain AS aqi_explain, COUNT(st.aqi_id) AS aqi_count FROM aqi aqi LEFT JOIN statistics st ON st.aqi_id = aqi.aqi_id GROUP BY aqi.aqi_id, aqi.aqi_explain ORDER BY aqi.aqi_id ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(confirm_date, '%Y') AS year, DATE_FORMAT(confirm_date, '%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS aqi_count FROM statistics WHERE aqi_id > 3 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(confirm_date, '%Y'), DATE_FORMAT(confirm_date, '%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(confirm_date, '%Y') DESC, DATE_FORMAT(confirm_date, '%m') DESC

SELECT ( SELECT ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT gm.city_id) * 100.0 / 34, 2 ) FROM grid_member gm WHERE gm.state = 0 ) AS capitalCoverage, ( SELECT ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT gm.city_id) * 100.0 / 106, 2 ) FROM grid_member gm WHERE gm.state = 0 ) AS bigCityCoverage, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN aqi_id <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN aqi_id > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pollutionCount FROM statistics

SELECT gp.province_id AS province_id, gp.province_name AS province_name, COUNT(st.id) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN st.aqi_id > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pollution_count, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN st.aqi_id > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(st.id), 0), 2 ) AS pollution_rate FROM grid_province gp LEFT JOIN statistics st ON gp.province_id = st.province_id GROUP BY gp.province_id, gp.province_name ORDER BY gp.province_id ASC
